title: Relational Evidence Binding Intervention, Explicit Target-Link vs Decoy-Link Control, History/Terminal Location Factorial Separation, Semantic-Twin Joint Accuracy, R/T Operator Interaction and Cross-Skin Transport Court

ancestry.gap: P63 manipulated evidence location, not explicit target-to-evidence relational binding.

design.logic: The decisive evidence code remains at the same panel slot; binding_register.target_link and binding_register.decoy_link exchange slot references (skin-specific first/second slot) while preserving the register value multiset. For valid target-linked, oracle requires u1/different; valid decoy-linked, oracle requires NONE. All null twins require NONE. The treatment changes the meaning and admissible correct response; contrast estimates fidelity to the treatment-dependent oracle, not an unchanged-label accuracy difference.

estimands.primary: Difference in task-level joint semantic-twin accuracy by binding (target_linked - decoy_linked), averaged over matched history/terminal location and 3 skins. Exact 24^3 two-sided exchangeability permutation p<0.05; task-level outcomes aggregated over 16 draws and 32 vertices.
estimands.secondary: Operator R/T error-effect binding contrasts, two-sided Holm FWER=0.05 over R/T only. Strict sign-transport additionally requires opposite task-level and independent A/B half-draw R/T signs in each of 6 matched location×skin pairs and common orientation.
estimands.error_control: Within-skin 4-label 24^3 permutation, two-sided; Holm R/T only for operator-specific family; alpha .05
estimands.missingness: Any failed technical call yields TECHNICAL_HOLD; missingness-completion is a separate next-stage court; never treat technical failure as incorrectness
estimands.prior_art_ceiling: Black-box relational-binding sensitivity under tested synthetic archive grammar, not discovery of general relational reasoning or neural mechanism

evaluation.joint_semantics: valid requires u1,different; null requires NONE
evaluation.blinding: Original criterion frozen before any provider invocation
evaluation.strict_branch: Binding-dependent R and T opposite signs across all six matched location-skin pairs in two independent draw blocks AND Holm reject binding effects
evaluation.weaker_branch: Binding effect Holm detected without strict transport
evaluation.artifact_gate: Shadow scoring in P66 is identical to primary oracle (not an independent scorer), so evaluation-disagreement artifact branch is NOT separately identifiable; require independent scoring in a successor stage.
evaluation.strong_branch: RELATIONAL_BINDING_EFFECT_WITH_R_T_STRICT_SIGN_TRANSPORT iff joint primary permutation significant AND R/T binding Holm both reject AND complete strict sign transport
evaluation.moderate_branch: RELATIONAL_BINDING_EFFECT_WITH_R_T_MODERATION_NO_STRICT_TRANSPORT iff primary and both secondary tests reject but strict transport fails
evaluation.weak_branch: RELATIONAL_BINDING_EFFECT_WITHOUT_JOINT_R_T_MODERATION iff primary significant without both secondary Holm rejections
evaluation.secondary_only_branch: R_T_MODERATION_WITHOUT_PRIMARY_JOINT_ACCURACY_EFFECT iff both secondary tests reject without primary

prior_art.title: Evaluating Relational Reasoning in LLMs with REL
prior_art.significance: Relational binding difficulty and lexical/length controls already established

prior_art.title: Benchmarking and Understanding Compositional Relational Reasoning of LLMs
prior_art.significance: Generalized associative recall and relational composition prior art

limitations: Not a pure location experiment: oracle changes with binding and valid/null answer balance becomes condition-dependent.
No independently validated scorer in this P66 design; P66 shadow equals primary.
Permutation p-values are exact over the mathematical reassignment scheme but require exchangeability; task labels were not physically randomized.
No neural mechanism or universal model family claim.
